Have enough to answer; character/session data lives in D1 (`characters` table) + KV (`session:<id>`), confirmed via docs — no further files needed.

## Answer

**Login** — `frontend/src/app/services/auth.service.ts`. There's no server auth; `login(username)` checks `localStorage` for key `ai_dnd_user_<lowercase name>`, loads it if present, or creates an empty `UserProfile` and persists it (also to the active-session key `ai_dnd_user`). `login.component.ts` calls this, then routes to `/characters` if the profile has no campaigns, otherwise shows saved `CampaignSlot`s.

**Campaign storage** — Campaigns are a **frontend-only, localStorage concept** (`CampaignSlot` in `frontend/src/app/models/game.models.ts`), each pointing at a Worker `sessionId`/character. They live inside `UserProfile.campaigns`, saved under `ai_dnd_user_<name>` (and mirrored to `ai_dnd_user`). The real game data lives server-side: character rows in D1 (`characters` table, see `worker/migrations/0001_initial_schema.ts`) and session state in KV under `session:<id>` (`worker/src/services/session.ts`, `sessionKey(id)`), with 20-turn history trimmed and a 7-day TTL.

**Deleting a campaign slot** — `login.component.ts`'s `deleteCampaign()` calls `AuthService.removeCampaign(slotId)`, which only filters the slot out of `profile.campaigns` and calls `persist()` to rewrite `localStorage`. **No HTTP request is made.** The server-side character (D1 row) and its KV session are untouched and continue to exist — only the local pointer to them is removed, so the character becomes unreachable from the UI (per `auth.service.md`: "`removeCampaign` only deletes the slot. It doesn't delete the character on the server.").
